findings.summary: EDAC unavailable: fixture no EDAC; no recognized kernel memory-error signature matched — hardware memory integrity not established
skipped: required evidence incomplete: edac: fixture no EDAC

semantics.clear: all required evidence sources were complete and no collected evidence indicates the failure class
semantics.degraded: collected evidence contains at least one positive indication of the failure class, including retained evidence from a partial source
semantics.unknown: no indication was found but at least one required evidence source was unavailable, unsupported, inaccessible, malformed, or incomplete; innocence was not established
semantics.decision_latency: duration from interrogation start until every requested accusation reached a terminal verdict
semantics.mtti: duration from interrogation start until every requested accusation was cleared or established semantically void; null when any requested accusation is degraded or unknown
semantics.interrogation_complete: duration from interrogation start until receipt construction began after collection and evaluation completed
